title: Corporate Gym Discounts in NZ — How to Get a Cheaper Membership Through Work
meta_desc: Get cheaper gym memberships through corporate discounts with NZHL, Southern Cross & more
intro: Many Kiwis are unaware that their employer can offer discounted gym memberships through corporate wellness programs. With prices starting from $14.95 per week at Jetts Fitness, a corporate discount can make a significant difference. In this guide, we'll explore how to negotiate corporate rates and compare prices from popular NZ gyms.

sections.heading: What are Corporate Gym Discounts?
sections.body: Corporate gym discounts are negotiated rates offered to employees of a company, often as part of an employee wellness program. These discounts can range from 5-20% off the regular membership price, depending on the gym and the company's agreement. Some popular NZ gyms that offer corporate discounts include Anytime Fitness, Jetts Fitness, and Les Mills.

sections.heading: NZHL and Southern Cross Gym Discounts
sections.body: NZ Home Loans (NZHL) and Southern Cross offer gym discounts to their employees and members. For example, NZHL employees can get a discounted membership at Jetts Fitness for $14.95 per week, which is 10% off the regular price of $16.95 per week. Southern Cross members can get a 10% discount on Anytime Fitness memberships, which start from $24.95 per week.

sections.heading: How to Negotiate Corporate Rates
sections.body: To negotiate corporate rates, employees should contact their HR department or wellness program coordinator to inquire about existing gym discounts. If no discounts are available, employees can approach their employer to negotiate a corporate rate with a preferred gym. It's essential to provide evidence of the gym's regular pricing and the potential benefits of offering discounted memberships to employees.
